how_chosen.t_high: lowest 6-month risk where >= 75% of flagged validation patients died within 6 months
how_chosen.t_mid: highest threshold that still catches >= 80% of validation deaths within 6 months
how_chosen.max_interval_width: 90th percentile of bootstrap 80%-interval width on validation (about 1 in 10 patients is 'too uncertain')
how_chosen.max_model_disagreement: logistic and XGBoost 6-month risks differ by more than 25 percentage points
how_chosen.note: These are design choices. A hospital can tune them to its own capacity and values.
